question: What is used in the preparation of calcium sulphate hemihydrate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gypsum**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Calcium sulphate hemihydrate is commonly known as **Plaster of Paris**.
 
• The preparation of calcium sulphate hemihydrate involves heating **gypsum** (CaSO₄·2H₂O) to approximately 150°C.
 
• Gypsum is a naturally occurring mineral composed of calcium sulfate dihydrate.
 
• When gypsum is heated, it loses water and forms calcium sulfate hemihydrate (CaSO₄·½H₂O).
 
• Calcium sulphate hemihydrate is used in various applications, including construction, medical casts, and art.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sodium Hydrogen Carbonate**

 
 
• Also known as baking soda, it is used in baking, cleaning, and fire extinguishers.
 
• It is a chemical compound with the formula NaHCO₃.
 
 
 
• **Sodium Carbonate**
 
 
• Also known as soda ash, it is used in glass manufacturing, as a water softener, and in detergents.
 
• It is a chemical compound with the formula Na₂CO₃.
 
 
 
• **Copper Sulphate**
 
 
• It is used in agriculture as a fungicide and herbicide.
 
• It is also used in the electroplating process and as a laboratory reagent.
 
• Copper sulfate is a chemical compound with the formula CuSO₄.
